activeQuarterlyGoals.title: Raise Series C by end of Q3
activeQuarterlyGoals.description: Securing a tier-1 lead investor and building strong signaling relationships across target venture partners (including Sequoia, a16z, Greylock, Index, Lightspeed, and Conviction).
keyCriteria: Lead investor interest / full pitch requested
Venture partners with previous round relationships or active SaaS/AI focus

activeQuarterlyGoals.title: Hire Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
activeQuarterlyGoals.target: Experience scaling engineering team from 50 to 200+ engineers
activeQuarterlyGoals.description: Sourcing direct candidates and activating high-leverage talent connectors, advisors, and mentors who can introduce or evaluate proven VP Eng / CTO executives.
keyCriteria: Proven track record scaling tech orgs (50 to 200+)
Active candidate discussions with pending follow-up windows
Mentors and talent leaders actively offering candidate pipelines

activeQuarterlyGoals.title: Build AI Safety Relationships
activeQuarterlyGoals.target: Establish meaningful partnerships with researchers, institutes, and academic hubs
activeQuarterlyGoals.description: Deepening ties with AI safety researchers, organizations (Anthropic, ARC Evals, MIRI), conferences (EA Global, AI Engineer Summit), and academic labs (MIT CSAIL, Stanford CSAIL).
keyCriteria: Active research alignment with TerraGrid platform
Direct organizational touchpoints at Anthropic, ARC, MIRI, MIT/Stanford
